rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=80, recon_eta=30.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=70, train_n=0, rationale=iter-17 EMPTY-PATCH confirm from BASE_ITER=8 (canonical max-SSIM: T=80/val_n=70/eta=30/relax=1.0/every5/n_cg3/warmup5/recon_dc_solver=cg, SSIM 0.85335 PSNR 30.488 hr 0). SIX-BOX VERDICT: (a) prior SSIM ~0.8534 hr 0 (iters 8,10-16 all reproduce 0.853, iter-15/16 = 6th-8th bit-identical confirmations). (b) Failure mode = faithful-but-PSNR/RMSE-bounded DPS+hard-CG-DC on the REUSED constrained DDPM v4 prior; regime-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo where LD-FBP is near-complete, so the recon sits just past the ~0.81 FBP-SSIM floor but PSNR cannot clear the LD-FBP HEADROOM floor -> hr structurally 0. (c) Lever audit (NUMBERS): NFE T is the ONLY live SSIM lever, swept monotone 25->28->40->60->80 lifting SSIM 0.394->0.478->0.665->0.840->0.853 and now SATURATED (iter-8 T=80 +0.013 over iter-7 T=60, diminishing); T cannot go to 100 ROBUSTLY -- per-slice-per-step cost is NODE-DEPENDENT (slow nodes 0.194-0.207 s e.g. iter-8 1096s; fast nodes 0.146 s e.g. iter-15 820s/iter-16 821s), so T=100xval_n=70 = 1025s on a fast node but ~1453s on a slow node => BLOWS the 1200s/20-min wall non-deterministically; raising val_n for representativeness at T=80 also blows the wall on the conservative 0.2077 slow-node constant (val_n=80 -> 1329s). eta {1,30}: 30 is the operating point (eta=1 at iter-2 dropped SSIM to 0.2366). relax {0.3,1.0}: inert at the operating eta (iter-3 relax 0.3 flat 0.2377). DC-fidelity knobs (n_cg/dcstep_every/warmup) only pull the recon toward the sub-LD-FBP-floor low-dose sinogram -> cannot raise PSNR above the floor. (d) DECISION: EMPTY-PATCH {} -- all IN-SCOPE IN-BUDGET levers EXHAUSTED; the sole remaining lever is the OUT-OF-SCOPE v5 EMA-prior retrain (new ckpt). (e) Fits HARD 20-min: T=80/val_n=70 at the conservative slow-node 0.2077 constant = 1163s = 19.4min < 1200s wall (fast-node reproductions land ~820s). (f) BASE_ITER=8 (max-SSIM canonical), recon_dc_solver=cg HELD. PREDICT SSIM ~0.853, hr 0 (regime-bounded reproduction). The constrained-v4 row stays SSIM 0.8534 hr 0; real payoff awaits the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks + the planned EMA v5 prior, both out of this solvers scope.
